description: Open a drawing analysis JSON saved earlier (analyze_drawing with save_analysis_to, or the Imnoo FileStore analysis document) and register it as a drawing for the plan and export tools. Fully offline — no upload, no daily credit. Pass pdf_path as well so the drawing exports can draw on the original PDF and write next to it.

drawing_id.description: id to register the drawing under (default: the analysis id, else the file name)

pdf_path.description: path to the matching drawing PDF (needed for the ballooned/package PDF exports)

name: load_analysis
title: Open a saved drawing analysis (offline)
